description: Additive horizon fields for points.csv. Supersedes v1 (25 columns) with 4 new horizon-specific attributes. v1 consumers ignore the extra columns; v2 consumers read them for horizon dressing, LOD blending, and atmospheric density.

columns.name: horizon_distance
columns.note: distance from point to horizon line in cm; computed from radial distance and height_class

columns.name: sky_exposure
columns.note: 0..1 how much sky is visible from this point; f(height, slope, curvature)

columns.name: silhouette_weight
columns.note: 0..1 how much this point contributes to the horizon silhouette; f(height_class, convexity)

columns.name: atmospheric_depth
columns.note: 0..1 baked atmospheric perspective value; f(horizon_distance, mist)

naming_rule: No two columns may differ only by letter case (UE FName comparison is case-insensitive).
row_struct_note: User Defined Struct created once via Monolith blueprint.create_user_defined_struct. v2 adds 4 new float fields to the struct.
